theme_decision: dark navy blue, electric blue, white, light gray, cyan accents, RTL Arabic corporate website
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure full RTL (dir='rtl') on all public pages and admin panel. Brand name '2Morro Technically Solutions' must remain in Latin script while all surrounding text is in professional Arabic (Tajawal/IBM Plex Sans Arabic). Implement 6 public pages (Home, About, Services with ~20-25 items + detail view, Projects portfolio up to 50 items with filterable grid + detail pages + galleries, Implementation Models page with ~15 phased timelines, Contact page with WhatsApp and email only, no form, 404 page) and a fully secure Arabic admin dashboard at /admin with login, stats overview, full CRUD for services/projects/models, company settings, publish/draft toggles, ordering, and image upload. Ensure high-contrast cards, alternating light/dark sections, zero purple gradients, and robust data-testid on all interactive elements.
